description: VLA-friendly injection-level templates used by generate_granularity_input.py. The facts are concise profile context inferred from profile data, not general task commands.

placeholders.context_one: Consistency context if available, otherwise scene/table context.
placeholders.context_two: Second consistency context if available, otherwise participating user context.
placeholders.detail: A second augmented tendency fact, adaptation fact, object characteristic fact, or update override note.
placeholders.extra_or_participation: An additional profile tendency when available, otherwise participating user context.
placeholders.fact0: The first augmented suite-specific tendency fact.
placeholders.facts_joined: All augmented profile tendency facts joined by semicolons.
placeholders.suite_fact: The injection axis and split metadata fact.

four_sentence: These profile cues are separate from the concrete task command
eight_sentence: The profile note should help identify the relevant user tendency
The concrete robot action remains defined by the separate task command
